headline: JSW Energy Limited: NCLT-convened Unsecured Creditors meeting scheduled for July 20, 2026
sum: JSW Energy Limited notified the NSE of an NCLT-directed meeting of unsecured creditors, scheduled for 20 July 2026 under the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench direction.
detail: JSW Energy Limited has formally disclosed to the National Stock Exchange (NSE) the convening of a meeting of unsecured creditors of the company, directed by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench. The meeting is scheduled for 20 July 2026. This notice indicates that JSW Energy's insolvency resolution process is in the review/claims-admission phase, where unsecured creditors will assess claims, review the resolution plan (if any), and potentially vote on restructuring options under IBC governance.
